principles.text: Use the constrained DSL and selected spec. Match the bundled blode-icons references: 2-unit outlined strokes, round caps and joins, radius-3 corners on containers and simple interior details. Keep each mark optically balanced within its host. Inspect native proofs; structural checks do not establish craft approval.

rubric: Blode house family drawn from the bundled blode-icons library (MIT). Compare stroke weight, corner radius, clear silhouettes and interior mark balance at native 24px and downsampled 16px against the references. Recurring elements keep the same geometry across the set (the tick in circle-check, the arrowhead in arrow-down-square, the chevron, the plus, the bell and bin bodies); check any drawing that reuses one against the sibling that already carries it. Report unresolved defects; do not infer quality from structural validity.
